description: INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS and REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS surface: PRIMARY KEY / UNIQUE / FOREIGN KEY rows with live's cell values (IS_DEFERRABLE NO, INITIALLY_DEFERRED YES, ENFORCED NO), SYS_CONSTRAINT_ auto-naming vs explicit CONSTRAINT names, one row per constraint for composite keys, cross-schema listing, joins against INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES, ALTER TABLE DROP/ADD PRIMARY KEY / DROP UNIQUE / DROP FOREIGN KEY lifecycles (a re-added key auto-names itself; DROP UNIQUE preserves a same-column FK), and REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS tying an FK to its parent key's name. Tests run in the PUBLIC schema to match the measured catalog/schema cells. Converted 1:1 from ddl/TableConstraintsTest (now retired).

steps.sql: USE SCHEMA public
CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR)

SELECT CONSTRAINT_CATALOG, CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA, STARTSWITH(CONSTRAINT_NAME, 'SYS_CONSTRAINT_'), TABLE_CATALOG, TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, CONSTRAINT_TYPE, IS_DEFERRABLE, INITIALLY_DEFERRED, ENFORCED FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'USERS' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'PRIMARY KEY'
USE SCHEMA public
CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER, code VARCHAR UNIQUE, name VARCHAR)

SELECT CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA, STARTSWITH(CONSTRAINT_NAME, 'SYS_CONSTRAINT_'), TABLE_NAME, CONSTRAINT_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'PRODUCTS' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'UNIQUE'
USE SCHEMA public
CREATE TABLE departments (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR)
CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER, dept_id INTEGER REFERENCES departments(id), name VARCHAR)

SELECT CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA, STARTSWITH(CONSTRAINT_NAME, 'SYS_CONSTRAINT_'), TABLE_NAME, CONSTRAINT_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'EMPLOYEES' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'FOREIGN KEY'
USE SCHEMA public
CREATE TABLE orders (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_number VARCHAR UNIQUE, customer_id INTEGER)
SELECT CONSTRAINT_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'ORDERS' ORDER BY CONSTRAINT_TYPE
USE SCHEMA public
CREATE TABLE logs (timestamp INTEGER, message VARCHAR)
SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'LOGS'
USE SCHEMA public
CREATE SCHEMA schema1
CREATE TABLE schema1.table1 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE SCHEMA schema2
CREATE TABLE schema2.table2 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'PRIMARY KEY' AND TABLE_SCHEMA = 'SCHEMA1' AND TABLE_NAME = 'TABLE1'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'PRIMARY KEY' AND TABLE_SCHEMA = 'SCHEMA2' AND TABLE_NAME = 'TABLE2'
USE SCHEMA public
CREATE TABLE items (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR)

SELECT t.TABLE_NAME, tc.CONSTRAINT_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES t INNER JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS tc ON t.TABLE_NAME = tc.TABLE_NAME AND t.TABLE_SCHEMA = tc.TABLE_SCHEMA WHERE t.TABLE_NAME = 'ITEMS'
USE SCHEMA public
CREATE TABLE t1 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE t2 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE t3 (id INTEGER, code VARCHAR UNIQUE)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'PRIMARY KEY' AND TABLE_NAME IN ('T1', 'T2', 'T3')
USE SCHEMA public
CREATE TABLE test_table (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
SELECT CONSTRAINT_CATALOG = TABLE_CATALOG, CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA = TABLE_SCHEMA FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'TEST_TABLE'
USE SCHEMA public
CREATE TABLE dp (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'DP' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'PRIMARY KEY'
ALTER TABLE dp DROP PRIMARY KEY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'DP' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'PRIMARY KEY'
USE SCHEMA public
CREATE TABLE dp2 (a INTEGER, b INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (a, b))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'DP2' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'PRIMARY KEY'
ALTER TABLE dp2 DROP PRIMARY KEY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'DP2' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'PRIMARY KEY'
ALTER TABLE dp2 ADD PRIMARY KEY (a)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'DP2' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'PRIMARY KEY'
USE SCHEMA public
CREATE TABLE du (a INTEGER UNIQUE, b INTEGER)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'DU' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'UNIQUE'
ALTER TABLE du DROP UNIQUE (a)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'DU' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'UNIQUE'
USE SCHEMA public
CREATE TABLE fk_parent (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE fk_child (x INTEGER REFERENCES fk_parent(id))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'FK_CHILD' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'FOREIGN KEY'
ALTER TABLE fk_child DROP FOREIGN KEY (x)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'FK_CHILD' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'FOREIGN KEY'
USE SCHEMA public
CREATE TABLE fk_parent2 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE fk_child2 (y INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY (y) REFERENCES fk_parent2(id))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'FK_CHILD2' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'FOREIGN KEY'
ALTER TABLE fk_child2 DROP FOREIGN KEY (y)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'FK_CHILD2' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'FOREIGN KEY'
USE SCHEMA public
CREATE TABLE rc_parent (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE rc_child (a INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY (a) REFERENCES rc_parent(id))
SET fkname = (SELECT CONSTRAINT_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'RC_CHILD' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'FOREIGN KEY')
SET pkname = (SELECT CONSTRAINT_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'RC_PARENT' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'PRIMARY KEY')
SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT_IF(UNIQUE_CONSTRAINT_NAME = $pkname) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS WHERE CONSTRAINT_NAME = $fkname
USE SCHEMA public
CREATE TABLE nc_parent (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE nc_child (a INTEGER, CONSTRAINT my_fk FOREIGN KEY (a) REFERENCES nc_parent(id))
SELECT CONSTRAINT_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'NC_CHILD' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'FOREIGN KEY'
USE SCHEMA public
CREATE TABLE ck (a INTEGER, b INTEGER, c VARCHAR, CONSTRAINT my_pk PRIMARY KEY (a, b), CONSTRAINT my_uq UNIQUE (c))
SELECT CONSTRAINT_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'CK' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'PRIMARY KEY'
SELECT CONSTRAINT_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'CK' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'UNIQUE'
USE SCHEMA public
CREATE TABLE mu (a INTEGER, b INTEGER, CONSTRAINT uq_ab UNIQUE (a, b))
SELECT CONSTRAINT_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'MU' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'UNIQUE'
USE SCHEMA public
CREATE TABLE ck2 (a INTEGER, b VARCHAR, PRIMARY KEY (a), UNIQUE (b))
SELECT STARTSWITH(CONSTRAINT_NAME, 'SYS_CONSTRAINT_') FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'CK2' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'PRIMARY KEY'
SELECT STARTSWITH(CONSTRAINT_NAME, 'SYS_CONSTRAINT_') FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'CK2' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'UNIQUE'
USE SCHEMA public
CREATE TABLE anc (a INTEGER, b INTEGER, c VARCHAR)
ALTER TABLE anc ADD CONSTRAINT anc_pk PRIMARY KEY (a, b)
ALTER TABLE anc ADD CONSTRAINT anc_uq UNIQUE (c)
SELECT CONSTRAINT_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'ANC' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'PRIMARY KEY'
SELECT CONSTRAINT_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'ANC' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'UNIQUE'
USE SCHEMA public
CREATE TABLE erc_parent (id INTEGER, CONSTRAINT erc_pk PRIMARY KEY (id))
CREATE TABLE erc_child (a INTEGER, CONSTRAINT erc_fk FOREIGN KEY (a) REFERENCES erc_parent(id))
SELECT CONSTRAINT_NAME, UNIQUE_CONSTRAINT_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS WHERE CONSTRAINT_NAME = 'ERC_FK'
USE SCHEMA public
CREATE TABLE dpn (a INTEGER, CONSTRAINT dpn_pk PRIMARY KEY (a))
SELECT CONSTRAINT_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'DPN' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'PRIMARY KEY'
ALTER TABLE dpn DROP PRIMARY KEY
ALTER TABLE dpn ADD PRIMARY KEY (a)
SELECT STARTSWITH(CONSTRAINT_NAME, 'SYS_CONSTRAINT_') FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'DPN' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'PRIMARY KEY'
USE SCHEMA public
CREATE TABLE ufp (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE uf (z INTEGER UNIQUE REFERENCES ufp(id))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'UF' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'UNIQUE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'UF' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'FOREIGN KEY'
ALTER TABLE uf DROP UNIQUE (z)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'UF' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'UNIQUE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'UF' AND CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'FOREIGN KEY'
